basics.name: John Walley
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 15+ years of experience building high-performance, data-intensive applications and developer tools. Specialises in TypeScript, React, and large-scale data visualisation, with a focus on performance, system design, and developer experience. Experienced leading technical direction, designing scalable architectures, and delivering complex products end-to-end—from rendering-heavy frontends to APIs, build systems, and deployment pipelines. Strong track record of building high-leverage tools that simplify complex systems.

work.name: Cambridge Intelligence
work.summary: Senior engineer working on high-performance data visualisation products for large-scale graph, temporal, and geospatial data.
highlights: Contributed to frontend architecture and API design for performance-critical data visualisation systems handling large, complex datasets.
Influenced product and architectural direction across rendering, state management, and developer-facing APIs.
Improved developer experience through tooling, documentation, and system design, reducing friction in building and extending visualisation features.
Worked cross-functionally with product and design to deliver complex, high-performance UI features with strong usability constraints.
Built interfaces for exploring and manipulating large-scale, stateful data models, including graph and temporal systems.

work.name: Mulberry House Software
work.summary: Founded and led a consultancy delivering data-driven applications and developer tooling, working hands-on across architecture, implementation, and product direction.
highlights: Designed and delivered full-stack applications and developer-facing tools across multiple industries, owning projects end-to-end from concept to production.
Built and deployed scalable systems including frontend applications, APIs, and cloud-based infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
Developed a floor-planning application in collaboration with [Reno](https://www.renovatewithreno.co.uk/), a UK home-renovation startup.
Designed and delivered data visualisation tools for the pensions industry in partnership with [Financial Canvas](https://www.financialcanvas.co.uk/).

Created and maintained open-source data visualisation libraries ([Allotment](https://allotment.mulberryhousesoftware.com/) and [Pennant](https://pennant.vega.xyz/)) with 200,000+ weekly downloads, used in production by the [Vega](https://vega.xyz/) trading network.
Led technical delivery while growing a consultancy, balancing hands-on engineering with architecture, client collaboration, and product decisions.

work.name: Redgate
highlights: Improved adoption of a database deployment tool used in CI/CD pipelines through product and UX improvements.
Introduced in-product analytics to support data-driven product decisions and prioritisation.
Worked closely with UX and engineering to define and prioritise features.

work.name: Redgate
work.summary: Developed tooling to streamline SQL Server database deployment within release pipelines.
highlights: Built features to improve reliability and usability of database deployment workflows in production environments.

work.name: Sungard
highlights: Contributed to a scalable framework powering high-performance financial risk analytics.
Developed a tracing JIT compiler enabling C# financial models to execute efficiently on GPUs.

work.name: Earlier Career
work.summary: Held roles across high-performance computing, applied research, and developer tooling:
highlights: High Performance Computing Developer at Fidelity.
Application Engineer at MathWorks, acting as UK technical contact for parallel computing tools.
Research Scientist at QinetiQ, working on multi-sensor fusion, object tracking, and defence systems.
